title: Average coverage is not enough: per-facility reliable conformal prediction for urban parking-occupancy forecasting — replication package

creators.name: Abdelmagid, Mohamed
creators.affiliation: Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

description: Replication package: seven interval-forecasting methods on 50 parking facilities in two cities under a delay-aware protocol, with a two-level evaluation standard separating population-level from per-facility validity. Code MIT. Birmingham-derived data CC BY 4.0. Belgrade data are NOT redistributed for rights reasons; the acquisition route, schema and SHA-256 of every withheld file are provided. See DATA_AVAILABILITY.md.
